## Purpose
`doctor.ts`'s `DoctorCheckStatus` is the clearest exemplar of this cluster: a small closed string-literal union (`"ok" | "warn" | "fail" | "skip"`) used to classify the health of one probed thing, paired with a `normaliseStatus` helper that narrows an arbitrary backend string into the union safely. `api-client.ts` and `dashboard.ts` don't declare their own `*Status`-suffixed type in the three read exemplars — `api-client.ts`'s `ApiError.status` is a raw HTTP status `number`, and `dashboard.ts`'s status-like fields (`SpecRow.status`, `SessionRow.status`) stay as loose `string`/`string | null` rather than narrowed unions. Treat `DoctorCheckStatus` as the house pattern to follow for a NEW narrow status enum; don't assume every `lib/` module narrows its status fields this way — several deliberately leave them as `string`.

## Convention
Folder: apps/dashboard/src/lib/** · Extension: .ts · Files of this role in this subproject: 4
Where a status is narrowed, it's `export type XStatus = "a" | "b" | "c" | "d";` (all-lowercase wire values) declared near the top of the module, right above the interface(s) whose field it types. When the backend can emit strings outside the union (or the value is user-facing telemetry not fully controlled by this repo), a `normaliseX(s: string): XStatus` function narrows it with an explicit safe fallback (`doctor.ts` defaults an unrecognised check status to `"warn"`, never throws) rather than casting.

## How to apply
When a new backend command result carries a bounded set of outcome strings that the UI branches on (badge colour, icon), declare an `export type XStatus = "a" | "b" | ...;` next to the DTO it types and add a `normaliseX` narrowing helper if the raw JSON isn't already guaranteed to match. If the field is genuinely open-ended or only ever compared by literal string equality in one place (as `SpecRow.status`/`SessionRow.status` currently are), leaving it as `string` is consistent with the existing code — don't retrofit a union onto every status-named field on principle.

## Examples
- Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/doctor.ts (DoctorCheckStatus, normaliseStatus)
- Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/api-client.ts (ApiError.status as counter-example — raw number, not a narrowed union)
- Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/dashboard.ts (SpecRow.status/SessionRow.status as counter-example — loose string)
